newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Jan-Aug cotton imports fall 2.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Jan-Aug cotton imports fall 2.9 pct.

text.p: South Korea's cotton imports for the first eight month fell 2.9 percent to 254,226 tonnes this year from 261,775 tonnes a year earlier, an official at the Spinners and Weavers Association of Korea (SWAK) said on Tuesday.
The decrease in cotton imports mainly reflected high prices in the international market, the SWAK official said.
In addition, downsizing of the industry also helped reduce imports, he said.
"The spinning and weaving industry needs a lot labour forces but the industry has no choice but to reduce its facility due to high wages," he added. "We expect the downsizing will continue."
South Korea's cotton imports in 1995 totalled 369,910 tonnes.
The official said the United States supplied 60 percent of the total in 1995, followed by the Commonwealth of Independent States with 30 percent and Australia with five percent.
